description: Steam Deck player report (T4 'Dakka Time' step 5, 1280x800): with every gun assigned, the D-pad just looped round the weapon rows - Slugga -> Kombi-weapon -> Twin sluggas -> Slugga - and there was no press that moved the right panel itself, so CURRENT TARGETS, 'Use GRENADE', 'Shoot All Remaining' and 'Start Action' stayed clipped below the fold and unreachable. This scenario drives the nested-panel D-pad model on the pad at the Deck's resolution and asserts every rule of it: (1) LEVEL 1 - the weapon walk CLAMPS, so DOWN off the last row does not wrap, it exits to the containing panel; (2) LEVEL 2 - the panel walks a ROW at a time (Clear All / Undo Last / Confirm count as one) and scrolls itself so the row being focused is on screen, which is how the clipped rows become reachable at all; (3) the ends CLAMP - extra presses at the bottom leave focus put instead of looping back to the top; (4) LEFT/RIGHT picks within the focused row and clamps at its edges; (5) the exit is REVERSIBLE - walking back up re-enters the weapon tree at its last row, and off its first row exits upward onto the control above; (6) none of it disturbs the three staged assignments, and Start still confirms into roll_da_dice. Menu navigation runs at the default window size (runner clicks/glides are logical-space); the window drops to 1280x800 once the lesson is loaded, before any assertion.

steps.comment: fresh container / fresh user:// = the first-launch nudge is up and swallows the pad menu navigation below. Dismiss it if present.
LB claims pad mode so the tutorial renders pad copy and the virtual cursor arms

STEAM DECK EMULATION: 1280x800 physical -> the canvas_items/expand stretch yields a 1920x1200 logical canvas at 0.667 scale, exactly what the Deck renders. Done AFTER the glide/click menu steps (runner clicks are logical-space and would land wrong under a non-1.0 scale); everything from here is joy buttons + scripts only.
RB cycles the acting unit to the Boyz
D-pad parks the virtual cursor (the picker glides left it live; A would be a click, not Assign). Only one target is eligible, so the ring does not move.
down onto the Slugga row
aim the Sluggas at the Witchseekers
the kombi-weapon has DEVASTATING WOUNDS, so assigning it can open the attacker-choices dialog - confirm it to commit the assignment (tolerant: no-op if it did not appear)

the panel walks a ROW at a time from here

the containing panel SCROLLED to bring the previously-clipped row on screen
the row that was clipped at the start of this scenario is now fully on screen and focused
pressing DOWN at the bottom must NOT wrap round to the top
clamped: extra presses at the end of the chain leave focus where it is
back up to the Clear All / Undo Last / Confirm row
D-pad LEFT picks WITHIN the focused row
and clamps at the row's edge instead of wrapping
UP out of the button row
UP again walks back INTO the weapon tree

re-entered at the tree's LAST row, the one nearest where the player walked in from
and the weapon walk resumes normally
UP off the FIRST weapon row exits upward
NO WRAP at the top end either
exits onto the first panel control ABOVE the tree
